title: Stages
description: The numbered stages of the TC39 process in ascending order, followed by its terminal stages.

Stage.title: Stage
Stage.description: A numbered or terminal stage of the TC39 process.

stage.description: The stage identifier, such as "2.7" or "withdrawn".

isTerminal.description: Whether the stage ends a proposal's progression through the process.

isOnPathToInclusion.description: Whether proposals at this stage remain on the path to inclusion in a standard or have successfully completed it.

status.description: What it means for a proposal to be at this stage.

entranceCriteria.description: What a proposal must have in order to enter this stage; plain text that may contain a newline-separated Markdown bullet list.

purpose.description: What the committee and champions aim to accomplish while a proposal is at this stage; plain text that may contain a newline-separated Markdown bullet list.
